Hold the Line.name: Hold the Line
Hold the Line.description:
🛡️ You can stand between a blow and the people behind you, and stay standing.

🎯 Good for defenders and anyone who shields civilians in a fight.
📋 Requires level 16 and Blocking 15.

📈 Grants: Blocking +10
Hold the Line.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has learned to take hits on purpose: they angle a guard, a shield, armor or their own toughened limbs to turn an impact, brace their stance and keep their feet to protect someone behind them. Show it in a planted stance and a refusal to give ground. Limits: it reduces and redirects impacts rather than stopping all harm; a strong enough blow still injures, and blocking blades, acid or flame with bare arms still costs them.
